name: Corrupt Primal of Water

facts.text: The four Corrupt Primals rise at the waterfall bridge after the voices; Olcasgean wakes only when all four are dead. Their shared line is 'We shall protect.'
Level 83, 125,000 health. Below 30% it walks to its pool once, cannot be hurt while it retreats, heals a sixth of its health and comes back.
It sends a target to one of two fixed spots by the falls.

story: The rivers of Hy Brasil run toward the hollow now, and the water that reaches it stays. The Primal of Water is what the Root made of it: a guardian that remembers it was a spring. Hurt it badly and it does what water does when it is wounded. It goes home. It slides back into its pool, where nothing can reach it, and drinks, and comes back a sixth of itself the stronger. It does this once. The Sylvan say a spring can only forgive itself so many times. It also has a current's habit of carrying people where they did not mean to go.
legend: Burn it to thirty, then stop: it runs to its pool and nothing hurts it there. Wait at the edge, let it heal, and kill it when it comes back. It only does it once. Watch for being swept to the far side of the falls.

aggro: The water remembers. The water returns.

phases.text: The spring goes home to drink.

death: The water... runs out to sea.

lairEntry: Four voices speak as one: we shall protect.

phases.text: The Water Primal sinks into its pool!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: The waters of Galladoria run clear for the first time.
